🔐 **Seatbelt v3 is officially live!**  

I’m thrilled to announce the newest release of **Seatbelt** – the free skill that empowers non‑developers to build safe, AI‑powered apps without writing a single line of code. 🚀  

> “Why code when you can *design*?”  
> Seatbelt lets you:  
> • **Choose templates** that match your business flow  
> • **Set security rules** in plain language  
> • **Add AI logic** with drag‑and‑drop blocks  
> • **Deploy instantly** with built‑in safety checks  

What sets Seatbelt v3 apart?  
* **Zero coding** – anyone can prototype in minutes.  
* **Built‑in AI safeguards** – your app won’t let unverified inputs slip through.  
* **Self‑hosting** – keep your data local and secure.  

Because I believe great tools shouldn’t cost you, Seatbelt remains **100 % free**. No trial, no hidden fees, just pure, open‑source power for creators of all skill levels.  

🛠️ **Ready to try?**  
1. Install Seatbelt via the [official repo](https://github.com/yourrepo/seatbelt‑v3).  
2. Follow the quick‑start guide and build your first app in under 10 minutes.  

If you’re curious or need help, drop a comment or DM me. Let’s build safer, smarter applications together!
